# Agent icons

Claude, Codex (OpenAI), and OpenCode logos identify compatible coding agents.
The unmodified SVGs come from Cloudflare's [agent setup page](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agent-setup/):

- [Claude](https://developers.cloudflare.com/icons/agents/claude/light.svg)
- [Codex](https://developers.cloudflare.com/icons/agents/codex/light.svg)
- [OpenCode](https://developers.cloudflare.com/icons/agents/opencode/light.svg)

Attribution: Cloudflare documentation contributors. Cloudflare publishes its
[documentation under CC BY 4.0](https://github.com/cloudflare/cloudflare-docs/blob/production/LICENSE)
and its [code under MIT](https://github.com/cloudflare/cloudflare-docs/blob/production/LICENSE-CODE).
The CSS scales the icons and inverts the Codex/OpenCode colors in dark mode.
